releases.name: Orient Star Three Hand
releases.description: The Orient Star Three Hand is part of Orient Star’s Sakigake design project, with an integrated stainless-steel bracelet and a clean three-hand dial without a date or power-reserve display. releases.name: Orient Star Skeleton 75th Anniversary
releases.description: Orient Star’s 75th-anniversary flagship skeleton watch explores the theme of time and space through an openworked mechanical movement. The hand-wound Calibre F9B82 offers over 72 hours of power reserve and +10/-4 seconds-per-day accuracy. Its 40 mm stainless-steel case is 9.5 mm thick, with sapphire crystal, a goat-leather strap and 30 m water resistance. Limited to 130 pieces worldwide, with a planned December 2026 launch.
